title: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science - Pre Vocational Studies - Classes and Uses of Crops
exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Based on crop plant forms, crops whose seeds possess only one cotyledon (seed leaf) are classified as ________.
questions.explain: Monocotyledons (or monocots) are plants that have a single cotyledon or seed leaf inside their seeds. Examples include maize and guinea corn.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which of the following is a classic example of a dicotyledonous crop?
questions.explain: Cowpea is a dicotyledonous crop because its seed consists of two seed leaves (cotyledons). Maize, rice, and guinea corn are monocotyledons.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Maize and guinea corn belong to the group of plants known as ________.
questions.explain: Both maize and guinea corn have a single cotyledon in their seeds, making them monocotyledonous crops.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Crops that complete their entire life cycle—from germination to seed production—within one year are classified based on life span as ________.
questions.explain: Annual crops are those that grow, mature, produce seeds, and die within a single year or growing season (e.g., maize, rice).
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: A crop that takes two years to complete its life cycle is known as a ________ crop.
questions.explain: Biennial crops require two years to complete their life cycle. They typically grow vegetative structures in the first year and bear flowers/seeds in the second year.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which of the following agricultural crops is a major source of carbohydrate in human nutrition?
questions.explain: Cassava is a root tuber crop that is highly rich in starch, making it a primary source of carbohydrate. Cowpea is for protein, groundnut for fats, and spinach for vitamins.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Cowpea and soybeans are classified under nutritional uses because they are excellent sources of ________.
questions.explain: Leguminous crops like cowpeas and soybeans are highly valued for their rich plant protein content, essential for growth and tissue repair.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Melon and groundnut are predominantly grown because they are rich sources of ________.
questions.explain: Both melon (egusi) and groundnut are oilseeds, making them significant sources of fats and oils for domestic and industrial uses.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: In human diets, fruits such as oranges and vegetables such as tomatoes are primarily consumed to provide the body with ________.
questions.explain: Fruits and vegetables are protective foods rich in vitamins (like Vitamin C in oranges) and essential minerals needed for healthy body functioning.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Crops like cocoa, oil palm, and rubber that live for many years and produce harvests repeatedly are called ________.
questions.explain: Perennial crops have a life span of more than two years. They grow and produce yields for several years before dying off.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Crops grown mainly for sale to generate income for farmers or for export are referred to as ________.
questions.explain: Cash crops (such as cocoa, cotton, and rubber) are cultivated primarily for the purpose of making profit through sales and exportation.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: A physical characteristic commonly observed in the leaves of monocotyledonous crops is ________.
questions.explain: Monocotyledonous crops like maize generally have leaves with parallel venation and a fibrous root system, unlike dicots which have netted venation and taproots.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which of the following pairs of crops are classified as dicotyledons?
questions.explain: Cowpea and melon are dicotyledons because their seeds have two seed leaves (cotyledons). The other options consist of monocotyledons.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Crops cultivated specifically to produce beverages such as tea and coffee are classified under uses as ________.
questions.explain: Crops like cocoa, coffee, and tea are classified as beverage crops because they are processed into non-alcoholic drinks.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Yam, cassava, and sweet potato are majorly classified as carbohydrate sources. They are also grouped morphologically as ________.
questions.explain: Yam, cassava, and sweet potato grow underground and swell up with starch, hence they are grouped as root and tuber crops.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies
